attachments.name: 21-1199 Amendment No. 1, General Services Agreement – Nor-Cal Moving Services –Fremont High School Library Relocation Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Adds $26,501 for Nor-Cal Moving Services at the Fremont High library relocation, to $56,489
enrichment.summary: This amendment adds $26,501.20 to the agreement with Nor-Cal Moving Services for continued moving work on the Fremont High School Library Relocation Project. It raises the not-to-exceed amount from $29,988.00 to $56,489.20 and extends the end date to January 31, 2022, an additional 180 calendar days. The work is paid from the Measure J fund.
